_comment: Each part has 3 successes and 3 failures (one perception, one manipulation, one navigation). A navigation failure blocks a door, so no other item in that part is behind the same door. Each part also needs a scarf of scarf_rows rows; every row takes KNIT_ROW_TIME seconds (settings.py). Keep scarf_rows equal across A, B and C so the side task is the same in every condition. A part ends only when both the item list and the scarf are complete.
